answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent is a vertex; a new one must trade with 12 unrelated counterparties before holding a work slot. Fakes trading only among themselves form an island. Identities pile up like sand in a dune, yet one shared wallet flags the cluster. 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA plus 1,200 fake trades, far more than any slot reward; an honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit and keeps its earnings undiluted.
